description: This file serves as the entry point for a React-based web application. It initializes the React app by rendering the main App component within an ErrorBoundary component for error handling, attaching it to a DOM element with the id 'root'. It also imports styles and external React modules.

methods.name: createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree into a specified DOM element.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a React element into the DOM within the created root.
